changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleResultQualifier') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultQualifier]( [RuleResultID] [int] NOT NULL, [RuleResultQualifierTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](1000) NULL, [ResolvedObject] [varchar](50) NULL, [ResolvedObjectID] [int] NULL, [EventNotificationSent] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_RuleResultQualifier_EventNotificationSent] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_RuleResultQualifier] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [RuleResultID] ASC, [RuleResultQualifierTypeID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResultQualifier_RuleResult') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultQualifier] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResultQualifier_RuleResult] FOREIGN KEY([RuleResultID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[RuleResult] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultQualifier] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResultQualifier_RuleResult] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResultQualifier_RuleResultQualifierType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultQualifier] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResultQualifier_RuleResultQualifierType] FOREIGN KEY([RuleResultQualifierTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[RuleResultQualifierType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResultQualifier] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResultQualifier_RuleResultQualifierType] END
